FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Clear answers.
In one place.

Still exploring? Create a demo account to try the manager conversation.

Open the demo account
What happens after I register?+

A demo profile opens in this browser. You can explore the map, compare plans, review sample documents and try manager messages. No payment details or identity documents are requested.

Can I deposit or withdraw real money?+

No. All balances, funding requests and credits are sample data. Requests can be reviewed in the separate team demo on the same browser. No real transfer takes place.

How is the weekly allocation calculated?+

The demo applies the selected weekly percentage to invested demo capital. For example, $250 × 3% = $7.50 for one week. It does not add an extra credit for every charging vehicle.

What does the 43% company figure mean?+

It is an unverified assumption for a company interest in a proposed network. The network scope and ownership evidence have not been provided. It does not mean ownership of 43% of all US charging stations.

Are the listed stations owned by EcoCharge?+

Ownership has not been established. Stations and photos are third-party public references. Operator names identify the public listings and do not imply a partnership or endorsement.

Who answers messages in this demo?+

The team demo can read and reply to messages saved in the same browser. The displayed manager is a placeholder until real team details are provided. Messages are not delivered to a live external support team.

Where is my demo information saved?+

The profile and demo activity are stored in this browser on this device. No registration email is sent and no server account is created. Use sample details. Clearing site data removes the local demo. Another device starts a separate demo.

What should I verify before investing real money?+

Verify the legal issuer, offering terms, eligibility, ownership evidence, revenue records, fees, withdrawal rules and risk disclosures. Sample documents and a working interface do not establish an investment right or prove returns.
